title: Agent Chat Request (v2)
description: Request body for POST /api/v2/chat. Identity is conveyed via headers (X-User-ID, x-request-id), not the body.

message.description: Operator prompt sent to the agent runtime.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier to continue an existing conversation. Omit to start a new session.

input_modality.description: Voice-readiness contract (SPEC-022 R-2): modality is metadata only. It never changes policy, auto-allow, or HITL outcomes, and can never approve or deny a parked confirmation.

response_schema.description: Optional JSON-schema dict for kernel-validated structured output (SPEC-017 R-2); passed through unchanged to the agent kernel.

model.description: Optional model selection (SPEC-024 R-3): a model id from GET /api/v2/models, or the reserved sentinel 'auto' (SPEC-072 R-2) to opt this turn into per-turn model routing. Resolution order is request model > session-pinned model > deploy-time default; an unknown id is refused with 4xx (fail-closed). 'auto' is accepted only when the catalog reports routing_available=true (otherwise 422), arms routing with the default as its base model, and is never itself a catalog model id.

remediation_intent.description: Opt-in conversational-remediation affordance (SPEC-078 R-1, OQ-1/OQ-2): when true — and only when the caller holds the reused deny-by-default remediate:stage action — the turn drives the delivered diagnose→propose→stage composition in-process, streaming the diagnosis narrative and parking the single proposed mutating call on the existing HITL confirmation card. Explicit and deterministic (never model-classified), so a normal turn cannot silently widen into a mutation-adjacent flow. Defaults false: an unset flag runs the unscoped single-agent path byte-identically. Gates the flow only — it never changes policy, auto-allow, or a parked confirmation's outcome, and it never dispatches (the signed at-most-one-dispatch worker alone executes, for a distinct human approver).

remediation_profile.description: The declared runbook profile the remediation-intent turn diagnoses and, if it declares a remediation_shape, stages (SPEC-078 R-1/OQ-4: post-deploy-verify, k8s-pod-degradation). Required when remediation_intent is true; an unknown or diagnosis-only profile fails closed at the route (4xx) and never opens an executor turn. Must be absent when remediation_intent is false.
